nom: Oars + Alps Matte Sunscreen Stick SPF 50

avis.texte: Absolutely love this product and will never go back to any other face sunscreen. Applying the sunscreen to my face and neck is so easy. The stick smoothly and evenly applies the sunscreen and doesn’t feel sticky or greasy like other products I’ve tried.
This sunscreen stick is awesome. It feels like silk gliding on your face and has an amazing matte finish. Not greasy and I can put makeup on over it with no issues. Love it.

avis.titre: I'd definitely order again but....I'd definitely order again but....
avis.texte: I love the matte finish and that the product comes with the expiration date. It also doesnt feel heavy on my skin. I didn't like that when I pulled the cover to expose the stick it fell out BUT I was able to slide it back into the sleeve and still use it - hence the 4 stars.

Absolutely love this stick - Oars and Alps has done it again. It's the perfect pocket-sized sunscreen. Works very well and not sticky or greasy - it feels like I have nothing on my skin. Actually, my skin feels very soft and hydrated after I put this on. These will make a great gift!
The sunscreen keeps flying out of the container when opening. Putting it on your face after its hit the beach is a bummer. I've purchased 5x and this keep shappening.

avis.titre: Sunscreen shouldn't melt in your pocket.Sunscreen shouldn't melt in your pocket.
avis.texte: Not sure if mine was defective or just melted completely. The plastic screw that helps rise the sunscreen when twisted was all that way through,And it was a hot day when it got delivered but the consistency shouldn't be like a Chapstick left in your pocket on a hot day. At the end of the day it's sunscreen so it should be somewhat heat resistant?
This Oars + Alps Matte Sunscreen Face Stick SPF 50 is Wonderful! It's easy to apply to face! It glides on smooth and is waterproof and sweat resistant. Great Value!

I really like this sunscreen stick. It is great for travel and on the go use. It arrived on a very hot day and wasn't melted at all. It glides on really smooth and doesn't feel greasy or leave a white caste. This is great for under makeup as well. I like that this is fragrance free and doesn't have that typical sunscreen smell. Overall this is really nice and I would order again.

I thought this would be quality like the other oars and alps products but the as soon as you pull the cap off, the sunscreen stick goes flying. I thought, well I push it back in and it will be fine. Nope. It does it every time you remove the cap. It creates such a good suction that it pulls the product out of its case every single time. $18 wasted, not to mention, the product is about 1” of actual stick…..
18 dollars for this much sun screen is insane. Only noticed because it fell right out when I opened it.

I was excited to try this portable matte water & sweat resistant SPF 50 sunblock, but the product tubing needs some serious work. My deodorant stick was loose inside, so it went flying out the first time I ever opened it! The sunscreen itself works really well, but it is super heavy and a little hard to blend into the skin. The best perk is that it’s matte, so it’s perfect for combo skin.

avis.titre: Lightweight, not sticky, easy to use and clean feel. So super convenient.
avis.texte: Great product. Goes on so easy and smooth. Feels great. Works well. Good ingredients. Small enough to take anywhere. Love it.

avis.titre: Not enough product for the price
avis.texte: I love this brand, I’m traveling by plain thought I’d get a travel size version since I usually get the spray. I’ll be lucky to have any left by day 2 since I need to re apply after so long being at the beaches of Mexico. Each time I open it I have to be careful to it falling out its case.
